name: The Roll Company (TRC) - Worli
description:
The Roll Company (TRC) serves handmade fresh kati rolls, rice bowls, and curries. Order for delivery with Swiggy and Zomato or call 7666127655. It is open in Worli and Bandra (West), from 10 am to 6 am Monday through Thursday and until 7 am on Friday and Saturday.

The Roll Company's signature dish is made by wrapping warm roomali rotis, a type of Indian flat bread, around a variety of meats, vegetables, and chutneys. We marinate each ingredient daily in a proprietary blend of Indian spices, creating a distinctive taste available nowhere else.

TRC has 2 locations in Mumbai: Worli and Bandra (West). BKC rolling soon.

featured_reviews.name: srabasti mondal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had ordered the butter chicken roll, chicken tikka Coriander and the chicken achari roll.
All of them were really tasty and very filling. one roll is enough for one person and a meal in itself. The chicken was juicy and the rolls were very light. I would definitely recommend the rolls, specially the butter chicken roll with extra spice. The best part is also that they have the spice option along with choice if add ons.

experience_details.value: Butter Chicken Roll, Chicken Tikka Coriander Roll

featured_reviews.name: The Glocal Journal
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Roll Company is now open in Juhu . I love TRC for the simple reason - wholesome scrumptious rolls .
It has a wide range of rolls .
I chose three different varieties in vegetarian.
Starting with Mushroom roll , the mushrooms were roasted nicely giving it that strong flavour .
The Bang Bang Batata had the yummy spicy flavour to it keeping it authentic yet tasty .
The paneer roll had a gravy which had a long lasting flavour . I loved the cottage cheese as it was so soft and delicate .
What I was surprised was with the pickle combination . The rolls combined with pickle tasted so delicious .
And ending my meal with the soft walnut chocolate brownie was heavenly . They were just gorgeous .
TRC packs it really well to ensure that the rolls are soft and intact .
What are you waiting for ?
Order it now
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear TGJ,

Thank you for the awesome review.
Glad to hear you enjoyed the rolls. Looking forward to serving you again soon.

Love and gratitude,
Jus

featured_reviews.name: Kiara Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently tried their Darshan's Paneer Harissa Roll and Dhaval's Paneer Makhani Roll. I was impressed with the generous stuffing of paneer in both rolls, which exceeded my expectations compared to similar offerings elsewhere.

However, I felt that the rolls could benefit from a bit more gravy to balance out the flavors. While the paneer stuffing was plentiful, the rolls felt slightly dry without enough gravy.

Overall, the rolls were delicious, and I appreciated the generous paneer filling. With a bit more gravy, they would be even more enjoyable. I'd still recommend trying them out!

featured_reviews.name: Harshali Ghone
featured_reviews.review_text:
"I'm utterly obsessed with TRC's Chicken Tikka Roll!

This incredible roll is a flavor sensation, with tender chicken tikka wrapped in a soft and crispy roti that's cooked to perfection.

The balance of spices, creamy sauce, and  veggies is pure magic, creating a taste experience that's both unforgettable and delicious.

Plus, it's incredibly filling and generous in portion size, making it the perfect meal.

If you haven't tried it yet, trust me and get your hands on one ASAP - your taste buds will thank you!"

featured_reviews.name: Geeta Rajbhar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently tried the chole roll at The Roll Company(TRC), and it was absolutely fantastic! The chole was perfectly spiced, packed with bold flavors, and the roll itself was fresh and soft, making it the ideal wrap for this delicious filling. Every bite was full of taste, and the portion size was generous without being overwhelming.
If you're looking for something that combines authentic Indian flavors with a modern twist, this chole roll is a must-try. Highly recommended for anyone who loves good food in a cozy, friendly atmosphere!

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Salve
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited McDonald's at Attaria Mall for breakfast, and it turned out to be a very pleasant experience. We had some free time before our office award event happening at Attaria Mall, so we decided to enjoy a quick meal at McDonald's — and as expected, it was a great decision.

The ambiance of the outlet was clean, welcoming, and perfect for a relaxing meal. The service was especially impressive. Sangita Ma'am attended to us with such warmth and professionalism. She ensured our order was taken smoothly, and the food was served quickly and with a smile. Her courteous approach and attention to customer satisfaction truly stood out, making our visit even more enjoyable.

As always, the food lived up to McDonald's reputation. We ordered our usual breakfast meals, and everything was served fresh, hot, and delicious. The consistency in taste and quality is one of the main reasons we love visiting McDonald's, and this outlet did not disappoint.

Overall, it was a delightful experience with great service, tasty food, and a comfortable environment. I highly recommend this McDonald's outlet at Attaria Mall, especially for a quick, satisfying meal with excellent customer service. Thank you, Sangita Ma'am, and the entire team!

featured_reviews.name: Chetan Bordawekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a very regular at McDonalds Atria Mall Worli. Over the period, their service is deteriorating day by day. First of of their Touch Screen kiosk near entrance don't work. It has touch screen problem. Then comes payment on any of kiosk. The system don't accept your payment. You have to pay at the counter. Then Why these kiosk are there? Yesterday even at counter, their online payment was out of order. Hence they were accepting only Cash.
Now Service. Very much delayed. One has to go to counter to remind them again & again. Food quality has also deteriorated over the period of time. Their Cokes are never chilled. There is a problem with their freezer. Last month, there was a problem with cooking items like Burger n all. Hence these items were unavailable for almost 10 days. Then there was a problem with refrigeration. Hence Ice Creams were not available.
McDonalds Management, please take this review seriously.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant
featured_reviews.review_text:
"If you are looking for the best Vada Pav and are willing to overlook the lack of facilities, this is the place to go. At ₹20, the Vada Pav is absolutely delicious.

However, be aware that this is a very bare-bones setup. There is nowhere to sit, the general vibe is lacking, and there are no washrooms on site.
Finding street parking is manageable, but unfortunately, there is no wheelchair-accessible parking.

For payments, having cash on hand will speed up your order significantly, though they will take UPI if you specifically ask for it. Overall, a great stop for Vada Pav enthusiasts on the go."

featured_reviews.name: swayambharat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Stage is set here for early monsoon and when it pours, time for hot piping Wada-Samosa-Pav at one and only- Manchekars, Worli Mumbai.
No fancy stuff here. Forget cutlery or a place to sit, but heaven for those who like their fare just like Granny cooked for you.
Walk in, push your way thru the crowd at the counter, grab your order, pay and step back a few steps to stand on the kerbside and relish piping hot goodness.
One thing is certain. Everything is fresh as the demand is so much right from early morning thru the day. Dishes keep changing so one is never certain what you get at that point in time.
Sometimes its Vadas, or Samosas or my fav Kanda Bhaji or Batata Bhaji. Have with Pav or by itself.
Hot. Fresh. Heavenly ♥️♥️♥️

featured_reviews.name: Lakshmi Menon
featured_reviews.review_text: Hot vada pavs guaranteed... They just keep making fresh batches and all things get over in a couple of minutes. The vadas have good flavour, chuntneys are also yum. Service is quick, people serving are genuine. Will definetly come back for more ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Dr.Saranya Sasi
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited Sadanand Coffee House in Worli with high expectations, having heard about their good South Indian food. Unfortunately, my experience was a letdown from the start. Upon arrival, I was disappointed to find that they don't accept digital payments like Google Pay or Paytm, only cash or card. This seemed like a significant drawback in today's digital age. The food quality was another major disappointment. I ordered the Mysore Masala Dosa and Coconut Oothappam, but what I got was far from authentic. The dosa was dry and tasteless, with a meager spread of red chutney that didn't justify its name. The khara(red chutney), a crucial component of a traditional Mysore Dosa, was missing or replaced with something else entirely. The Coconut Oothappam was just average, lacking the freshness and flavor I've come to expect from this dish. To make matters worse, the service was slow,  our orders took a long time to arrive, and the Fresh Lime Soda we ordered was just okay. Overall, my experience at Sadanand Coffee House was underwhelming, with too many misses and not enough redeeming qualities. With some improvements in payment options, food authenticity, and service speed, this place could live up to its reputation. Until then, I'd think twice before returning.

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Parulekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Somewhere between 2003 and 2004, while making sales calls in the Worli area, my manager took me to Vaishali Sweet and Lunch Home for lunch. He raved about it, saying it was one of the best places for Misal Paav and other snacks like Vada Paav, Usal, Samosa, and Sabudana Vada.

The first bite of Misal was simply divine. We finished our meal with a delightful Piyush. From then on, I became a regular at Vaishali, indulging solely in Misal Paav and Piyush.

I later introduced this gem to many friends and colleagues, and they all fell in love with it.

Now, let me tell you about the food. As I mentioned, try any dish here, and it’s worth every penny! Trust me, you won’t regret it.

Yesterday, I visited Vaishali after a long time. As usual, I ordered Misal Paav, and to my delight, the taste was just as good as it was 15 years ago. Most people are unaware of this spot because it’s not on the roadside but tucked away behind the shops at Worli Naka.

If you’re a true Misal Paav lover, make sure to visit this iconic joint!

featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are glad to hear that you enjoy the taste of our food. However, we deeply regret that your experience with our service and cleanliness did not meet expectations.

We take hygiene and customer service very seriously, and we will address these concerns with our team to ensure that the quality of service is consistently maintained. Regarding your concern about the quality of cheese and butter, we think there is some misunderstanding if you check our menu there are two options given for each product Regular and Premium. Regular means as you get in the market. And in premium version we provide everything in Amul brand. If we have to mislead the people then we would have displayed only amul boxes but we have kept there all the brands we use. We believe in transferent business. Not only butter and cheese we use 1st quality raw material to prepare our all menu items. We hope your doubt it clear. 

We appreciate your feedback and will strive to make the necessary improvements. We hope you will give us another chance to provide you with a better experience.

name: Masala Kitchen
description:
Gourmet Indian Delivery and Catering Kitchen cooking Progressive Indian Cuisine retaining traditional flavours, cooked in modern French progressive way.
Menu consists of dishes from across the Country kept true to their styles, flavours, and their soul, while bringing forward the rendition from Modern times.
Kerala Alapuzzha Fish Curry, Bengali Macher Chop, Maharashtrian Pitla Bhakri, Mangalorean Ghassi, Delhi Rajma Masala, Kashmiri Rogan Gosht are some of the top selling dishes on offer made with the highest quality of ingredients, with the kitchen slowly moving to a Zero waste process.

featured_reviews.name: Sonali Darge
featured_reviews.review_text:
Masala kitchen is located in worli. This is delivery kitchen
Recently ordered from Masala Kitchen.Masala kitchen is a best delivery.Delivery was quick.they give veg and non veg delivery.We ordered this yummmy nonveg  meal combo from Masala kitchen which was soo tasty and yummy.They serve different types of food.

featured_reviews.name: Aisha S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Masala Kitchen is a delivery kitchen located in Worli besides Casa De Cafe on Dainik Shivner Road...

This outlet is famous for its North Indian dishes and we ordered a few of their signature dishes... Like :-

1) Trio Chicken - 6 pieces of boneless chicken marinated in 3 different colours - orange, white and green it and grilled over the tandoor till well done... The taste of these 3 different marinations was amazing and lip smacking. Definitely recommended...

2) Chicken Tikka Biryani - The biryani was tasty and it consisted boneless pieces of chicken tikkas. Biryani flavour was nice. Liked the biryani out here.

3) Butter Chicken - Succulent pieces of chicken marinated in red tomato gravy and cooked till perfection... The only thing that it was lacking was the gravy was too sweet. Could have been a lot more better if they could make this savoury dish a little more spicy...

4) Parathas - Plain Parathas were cute and small in size and so you have to make sure to order more if u are ordering the food from here... Triangle size...

5) Angoori Gulab Jamun - 6 mini pieces of gulab jamun. The sizes were very small as it was angoori gulab jamun. Finished the dessert within no time. Service was quick and in time...

featured_reviews.name: Freeda Bhati
featured_reviews.review_text:
Masala Kitchen

This is a Delivery Kitchen that's specialize in North Indian and South Indian Cuisine.
One of the best thing that they keep posting about the food until they deliver you on your door step. This helps to track your order.
Prompt delivery and leak proof packing.

Had some lipsmacking food from this place...
We Ordered:
Mangalorean Sukha Chicken Tangdi: This was incredibly delicious and went well with Butter Naan..
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

Khade Masale Ka Murg:
Quite settle taste. The gravy is smooth in taste and no disturbance from khada masala.. Goes well with Roti & Rice
Can try!

Butter Chicken Biryani:
The creamy texture from butter chicken masala just lifted the taste of the biryani.
If you like mild biryani taste and don't wanna opt. For too spicy biryani then this one is for you.
Can Try!

Dessert: Moong Dal Halwa:
The taste is absolute divine with the Oozing goodness from ghee.
If they would have mad it to Caramel brown halwa. This would have been heavenly good.
Can Try!

The prices of the menu appeared perfect for the quality, Hygiene & quantity of the Food!
What a beautiful experience that they serve all of that comfort food.
Worth ordering!
I recommend this place!!

featured_reviews.name: Ronica Raj
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I had ordered my dinner from Masala Kitchen which is a delivery outlet located in worli.
The food was delivered on time hot and fresh.
I had ordered:
1. Chicken Tikka biryani: it was very less and as it was small portion. Only two chicken Tikka pieces were there. The biryani taste was ohk ohk. Not that great. It costed 200 rupees and for that small portion it was way too costly.
2. Chicken Gilafi Seekh: it was yumm!! Best dish! N worth the money. It was cooked Soo well and topped with cheese. They could have added a bit more cheese. But it was great anyways.
3. Make your own meal gravy combo: it consists of butter chicken, roti, salad. N roti was Soo soft. Not at all hard or burnt. Relli impressed! The butter chicken was flavorful and tasty. It had enough boneless chicken pieces. Salad was also good.
3. Moong dal halwa: it was not at all good. It was made in dalda which is not at all healthy and tasty. It was very very dry. I didn't like the taste at all. Halwa should alwys be made in ghee. Not at all recommended here.
Overall I loved the food. It was good. I had given special instructions not to make it too oily or too spicy and they prepared it accordingly. Good!

featured_reviews.name: Shreya Bharti
featured_reviews.review_text:
Masala Kitchen is one of the few good delivery options for Indian food in SoBo. Their packaging is neat and spill-proof; delivery is well on time. I tried the following items:

Salli Boti Bun Muska: this is a Parsi dish which I liked quite a lot. Very succulent salli boti stuffing inside the classic bun muska.

Murg Gilafi Seekh: I love seekh kebabs, though I didn't quite like this one due to overload of ginger.

Khade Masale ka Murg: a rich, medium spicy chicken gravy dish which I loved. Went well with butter rotis. Chicken chunks were quite tender and juicy.

Hyderabadi Mutton Dum Biryani: This was the best dish out of all. Loved the aromatic biryani with soft and delicious mutton pieces. Well balanced on spice.

Jalebi Rabri: Perfect end to a hearty meal with crispy jalebi and creamy rabri.

They had also provided mint chutney, raita and salad with the order. Thumbs up for that. Definitely gonna try out more items from the menu in future.

featured_reviews.name: Munawar Karbelkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered in these really delicious non vegetarian dishes from masala kitchen. They are a delivery kitchen based out of Worli and they serve some really good Indian food.

Here’s what we ordered:

1. Murg Gilafi Seekh - this was a really delicious and creamy and loaded with cheese

2. Khade masale ka murg with butter roti - the khada masala was really delicious and spicy. It had full blown Masalas with a whole load of succulent chicken pieces.

3. Butter chicken biryani - the butter chicken was really sweet and delicious at the same time. Completely like the quintessential butter chicken.

4. Rabri and jalebi - the Rabri was thick and really creamy and the jalebi was a good combination with it.

The food was served just in time, the packaging was great and the pricing wasn’t too expensive. Just brilliant.

featured_reviews.name: Atulya Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Masala kitchen is located in worli and is a delivery kitchen. The delivery was on time and the packaging was on the mark. This place is famous for it's north indian cuisine.
I tried the following items:-

1)Spiced Sweet Potato & Beetroot Tikki Chaat 5⭐
This was a Chaat with beetroot tikki in the base and amazing curd layer on top of it. On the top sweet potato fries were there on the curd. This was a creamy texture Chaat with a great start for a good dine.
Recommended!

2) Tulsi panner Tikka 5⭐
This was a panner Tikka marinated with flavorful spices and Tulsi. The panner was soft and presented with cubical pieces.This was delivered with mint chutney on the side and a side salad.

3)Malai Kaju ke Kofte 4.5⭐
This was the mains with sweet,thick and  creamy white  gravy with two pieces of Kofta in it. The koftas were great and so was the gravy. This was delivered with butter roti.

4) Amritsari Chole ki Achari Biryani 4.5⭐
The biryani was absolutely delicious,with a balanced combination of spices,chole, veggies with caramelised onion on top of it.
On the side raita was also good.
Recommended!

5)Moong Dal ka Halwa 5⭐
Delicious and Drool- worthy moong Dal ka halwa is a must try dessert.
Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Tanishka Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Masala kitchen

Spiced sweet potato & beetroot tikki chaat 😍
Mashed beetroot with an amazing twist curd and sweet potatoes on it 🤩
Tasted so amazing and was definitely an unique dish to have 😋

Mangalorean Sukkha Tangdi 🍗❤️
When your mom's mangalorean and you know the real authentic mangalorean taste you crave for it every now & then 🤩
Usually when i have mangalorean food at the restaurant its not the typical way it should be.
But this amazing sukkha by masala kitchen was just the way i love & had the typical mangalorean taste 😍
Highly recommended 💕

Khade masala ka murg with butter roti ❤️
So flavourful and tasted heavenly 😍
Good pieces of chicken with a lipsmacking gravy 🤩
Tasted good with the butter roti & is definitely a must try 🥰

Kashmiri gosht ki Biryani ❤️
Have 2 to 3 chunks of mutton with some good size of flavourful rice 🤩
Tasted fresh and delicious, a must try to all the Biryani lovers🥰
